traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus, Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Disruption meets imagination. A generational signature: radical ideals and visionary change. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Idealism that destabilizes more than it builds. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for disruption against imagination, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the disruption/imagination form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Generational and visionary themes rather than a personal day-to-day read.
shadow: Instability for its own sake collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.body: A viral solution may collect believers before anyone has had time to test if it works. Uranus square Neptune can make new platforms, anonymous funds, artificial images, or unverified tools spread through a crisis while hope fills the gaps in evidence. The first failure can become an excuse to chase the next version instead of asking what the experiment already proved. Slow the repeat cycle. Verify the source, ownership, results, and people carrying the downside before another round of attention or money turns the same uncertainty into a larger problem.
